title: acceptance_verdict
description: Phase 5b Cooling Acceptance Gate verdict (CONTRACT-04/05). PASS requires coverage_pct >= Y_pct AND utci_delta_c >= X_c. utci_delta_c = mean over shaded cells of (baseline_utci_c - shaded_utci_c) * (1 - solar_transmissivity); baseline_ref points at the persisted utci_grid.baseline_utci_c denominator. X_c=4 and Y_pct=70 are locked in Phase 0, immutable post-run.
